answer_quote: Yes. In this section the atheromatous plaque (the yellow, lipid/foam‑cell‑rich material on the left) is thickest in its most advanced zone, and directly beneath that zone the eosinophilic medial layer (smooth muscle) is noticeably attenuated/thinned compared with the fuller, more uniform pink band seen on the opposite (right) side of the wall.
